summary.key_theme: 公司受惠於電力基礎設施需求強勁，財報表現優異並獲分析師調升評級，儘管估值偏高引發市場對股價漲幅的擔憂。

bullish.title: Keybanc Upgrades Quanta Services to Overweight, Announces $807 Price Target
bullish.reason: Keybanc 分析師 Sangita Jain 將評級上調至 Overweight，並給出 807 美元的目標價，顯示市場對其未來成長動能的高度信心。

bullish.title: How Quanta's Raised 2026 Outlook Could Reshape Its Growth Story Ahead
bullish.reason: 公司在強勁的季度表現後上調 2026 年營收、獲利及現金流預期，顯示營運執行力持續增強。

bullish.title: Bull of the Day: Quanta Services (PWR) — What's hot? Power generation.
bullish.reason: 電力生成產業需求火熱，Quanta Services 作為關鍵基礎設施供應商，正處於產業成長的順風口。

bullish.title: 3 Reasons Growth Investors Will Love Quanta Services (PWR)
bullish.reason: 強調公司具備紮實的成長屬性，能為成長型投資人帶來卓越的長期回報。

bullish.title: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR) Delivers Accelerating Earnings Growth and Improving Fundamentals
bullish.reason: 通過成長篩選指標，顯示營收加速、利潤率擴張及強勁的盈餘修正趨勢。

bullish.title: If You Invested $1000 In Quanta Services Stock 20 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
bullish.reason: 回顧過去 20 年表現，年化報酬率超越市場 10.9%，強化投資人對其長期價值創造的信心。

bearish.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Stock Looks Pricey On Cash Flow And Earnings After 6x Run
bearish.reason: 股價經歷 6 倍漲幅後，基於現金流與盈餘指標顯示估值過高，可能限制短期上漲空間。

bearish.title: Is PWR a Buy Today as Growth Accelerates but Valuation Stays High
bearish.reason: 儘管獲利與積壓訂單創新高，但高昂的估值引發市場對成長速度是否能支撐股價的質疑。

bearish.title: Why PWR Down 11.7% in 3 Months and Whether Investors Should Buy Now
bearish.reason: 股價在過去 3 個月下跌 11.7%，顯示儘管基本面強勁，但市場情緒或獲利了結壓力仍對股價造成短期壓抑。

neutral.title: Are Construction Stocks Lagging Quanta Services (PWR) This Year?
neutral.reason: 僅為與同業 Tutor Perini (TPC) 的績效比較，提供產業背景資訊，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Keybanc Upgrades Quanta Services (PWR)
neutral.reason: 此為重複報導，僅確認了先前 Keybanc 的評級上調動作，未提供額外資訊。
